steps.title: Prepare BCA Working Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the final BCA solution using the Pierce BCA assay kit for x+1 wells (where x = 18 controls + 3 * n samples), providing 200 µl per well.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 65 °C for 8 minutes (00:08:00).

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Take readings immediately in a spectrophotometer at 562 nm.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the Optical Density (OD) is not above 1; if it is, do not analyze the data.

Calculate actual sample concentration using the formula: O.D./2 * slope(standards).
